body.statement: The main identification construction of \cite{SuRytgaardRavnEriksson2026} is formulated for two randomized trials whose treatment pairs share a common comparator.  Proposition~2 assumes that both observed-data bridge sets are nonempty.  It therefore does not address the arbitrary finite treatment-multigraph rank problem considered here.

attestation.note: The stable primary-preprint handle and proposition locator support the pairwise indirect-comparison scope statement.
